answer: Each identity grows one quartz crystal in a shared grove, tuned by a quill-signed deed only its grove keeper endorses; a crystal costs a one-time 70 POA seed-salt fee, sunk and never refunded. The keeper strikes each crystal once per epoch and a fake's resonance never matches its deed, so the crystal shatters and the identity is barred from the grove for five epochs. Ten clones need ten separately endorsed deeds, and a keeper endorsing a copy loses 30 POA of standing per fake, so no keeper vouches twice for the same hand; the cost cannot be pooled or reused.
